mcqs.question: At Semicon India 2025, held on 2 September 2025, which of the following was presented?
mcqs.explanation: The Vikram 32-bit chip was presented at Semicon India 2025 on 2 September 2025. Project Sanjeevani and the First Swachha Andhra Awards are associated with other events, while Patient Advisory Councils relate to the Global Patient Safety Action Plan.
